cohort: 31 pregnancies exposed to IL-1 inhibitors from seven countries, including 8 pregnancies exposed to canakinumab and 23 exposed to anakinra
finding: Data on IL-1 blockade and reproduction are generally reassuring, although one case of renal agenesis was reported in an anakinra-exposed pregnancy.
